text_blocks.snippet: Common and serious side effects associated with Jardiance (empagliflozin) vary from mild reactions to medical emergencies.

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Symptoms include a burning sensation when urinating, a frequent or urgent need to pass small amounts of urine, or cloudy/bloody urine.
Genital yeast infections: These can affect women (vaginal itching, burning, pain, or thick white discharge) and men (redness, swelling, or irritation around the penis and scrotum).
Increased urination: Because Jardiance works by helping your kidneys flush out extra glucose through your urine, you will need to urinate more often.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A life-threatening buildup of acid in the blood that can happen even if your blood sugar is normal or under 250 mg/dL. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, extreme tiredness, fruity-scented breath, and trouble breathing.
Dehydration and low blood pressure: Fluid loss can cause dizziness, lightheadedness, weakness, or fainting, especially when standing up.
Necrotizing fasciitis of the perineum: A rare but severe bacterial infection of the tissue between the anus and genitals, causing intense pain, redness, swelling, and fever.
Hypoglycemia (low blood sugar): Most common if Jardiance is taken alongside other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas, causing shakiness, sweating, confusion, or a fast heartbeat.
Severe allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, hives, and trouble swallowing or breathing.
Lower limb risks: An increased risk of lower limb complications or amputations, particularly in patients with a history of vascular disease or prior foot ulcers.
